name: mise-pack-a-punch-policy
mission: Stack workflow signals into one auditable quality, risk, and branch-readiness processor.

stackCoordinates.name: measurement-context
stackCoordinates.purpose: Capture event, actor, branch, and file-change context before running any enhancement.

stackCoordinates.name: risk-gate
stackCoordinates.purpose: Block secrets, risky workflow edits, and destructive shell patterns.

stackCoordinates.name: quality-stack
stackCoordinates.purpose: Run native lint, test, build, and syntax checks only when matching project files exist.

stackCoordinates.name: supply-chain-scan
stackCoordinates.purpose: Surface dependency and lockfile risk without creating recursive commits.

stackCoordinates.name: branch-advisor
stackCoordinates.purpose: Recommend the next branch/PR path without auto-merging.

stackCoordinates.name: evidence-report
stackCoordinates.purpose: Emit a single Markdown/JSON report artifact and optional PR comment.
